title: Model chain (v1)
description: The 'string of pearls' dependency graph, pushed on its own. It is the same shape as the model_chain object carried inside model_inventory, extracted so a producer can push the chain independently. Only structural keys are required; producer-added fields are allowed. Nodes are optional and describe what each id IS - a model, an ML Application, an AI System, a foundation model or an MCP server; an id with no node entry is a model, which is what every chain pushed before nodes existed is. Graph integrity (links resolve, no self-loop, acyclic) and the node kinds are enforced server-side, not by this schema.

nodes.description: What each id in the graph is. Optional: an id with no entry is a model.

link.description: A directed dependency: model 'from' hands data off to model 'to'.

node.description: One node in the graph. 'kind' is validated server-side against the node-kind vocabulary; an unknown kind is refused rather than silently treated as a model.
